title: Chargeable Delivery Miles for Fleet Units Delivered After the Delivery Window
content:
**Fleet delivery commitment terms, Vehicle Purchase Agreements**

How the chargeable delivery miles of a unit sold under a **Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement** are counted depends on when the unit was delivered against its delivery window.

**The delivery window.** The window ends 30 calendar days after the contract date. The contract date is day 0, so the last day of the window is day 30. "Days past the window" are the calendar days from that last day to the delivery date.

## Terms

1. **More than 15 days past the window.** For a unit delivered more than 15 days after the last day of the window, the chargeable delivery miles are 0.5 (one half) of the miles beyond the free radius, and never more than 50 miles.
2. **1 to 15 days past the window.** For a unit delivered from 1 to 15 days after the last day of the window, the chargeable delivery miles are the miles beyond the free radius less 4 miles for each day past the window. They are never fewer than 0.5 (one half) of the miles beyond the free radius.
3. **Within the window.** For a unit delivered on or before the last day of the window, the chargeable delivery miles are the miles beyond the free radius.

## Where the boundaries fall

| Delivery day, counting the contract date as day 0 | Days past the window | Term that applies |
|---|---|---|
| Day 30 or earlier | none | 3, within the window |
| Day 31 | 1 | 2 |
| Day 45 | 15 | 2 |
| Day 46 | 16 | 1 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical units)

**80 miles beyond the free radius.** One half of the miles beyond the radius is 40.

| Days past the window | Computation | Chargeable delivery miles |
|---|---|---|
| none (within the window) | miles beyond the radius | 80 |
| 1 | 80 less 4, which is 76; not below 40 | 76 |
| 10 | 80 less 40, which is 40; equal to the 40-mile floor | 40 |
| 12 | 80 less 48, which is 32; raised to the floor of 40 | 40 |
| 16 | one half of 80 is 40; not above 50 | 40 |

**130 miles beyond the free radius, delivered 20 days past the window.** One half of 130 is 65, which is more than 50. The chargeable delivery miles are therefore held at 50.
